Zenly Alternatives That Actually Work in 2026

Zenly closed on 3 February 2023 when Snap shut it down, and its fans have been looking for a replacement ever since. Here's what's closest in 2026, and what's better for nights out.

By the ontap team · 25 October 2026
Full disclosure: we make ontap, so it's on this list. We've tried to be fair about what every app does well and where ours isn't the right fit.

What made Zenly special

Zenly wasn't just location sharing; it was fun location sharing, showing where your friends were and what they were up to. Most replacements only do the dot on the map.

The best Zenly alternatives

Closest to Zenly

1. Snap Map (Snapchat)

See friends who share their location on a map inside Snapchat, plus public Stories from around you.

Platforms
iPhone, Android
Price
Free
Best for
Friend groups who already live in Snapchat.
Watch out
Location only, and not always real time; nothing about nights out, beers or recaps.

Snap owned Zenly, and Snap Map is where its ideas went. If your friends are on Snapchat, it's the natural replacement.

Best for close friends (iPhone)

2. Find My (Apple)

Apple's built-in location sharing: share where you are with chosen friends or family, indefinitely or for an hour.

Platforms
iPhone (built in)
Price
Free
Best for
Simple, private location sharing with a few close people.
Watch out
No social feed, no venues, nothing beyond a dot on a map.
Best for mixed iPhone and Android

3. Google Maps location sharing

Share your real-time location with chosen contacts from Google Maps, on iPhone or Android, and save lists of pubs to visit.

Platforms
iPhone, Android
Price
Free
Best for
Mixed iPhone/Android groups, and for saving lists of places.
Watch out
Not social; you have to set sharing up per person.
Best for seeing who's out tonight

4. ontap

Log a beer in one tap from a home or lock screen widget, with the bar you're at. See which friends are out on a shared map, race your friends in squads, earn 30+ badges and become Mayor of your local. Every month you get Last Call, a recap worth sharing.

Platforms
iPhone · App Store
Price
Free (an optional ontap Pro is coming)
Best for
Groups of friends who go out together and want logging to take one tap.
Watch out
No beer-by-beer ratings or tasting notes, and no Android app yet.

ontap brings back the fun part of Zenly for nights out: friends show up on a shared map when they log a beer, you can see who's out right now, and there's a monthly recap of everyone's nights. No 24/7 tracking: you're on the map when you're out.

ontap is the free iPhone app for logging beers in one tap and seeing which friends are out.

Get ontap free on the App Store

FAQ

When did Zenly shut down?

Zenly closed on 3 February 2023, as part of Snap's cost-cutting.

Is there a new Zenly?

Nothing has replaced it exactly. Snap Map is closest; ontap covers the 'who's out' side for nights out.
